question: Choose the correctly spelt word:
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. Cigarette .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Cigarette"** is correctly spelt. It refers to a thin cylinder of finely cut tobacco rolled in paper for smoking.
 
• Option 2 (**"Cigerette"**) is incorrect due to the spelling error in the placement of the letter **"e"**.
 
• Option 3 (**"Cigartte"**) is incorrect because it omits the letter **"e"** that follows the **"r"**.
 
• Option 4 (**"Cigarate"**) is incorrect because it completely misses the additional **"e"** required at the end.

Correct spelling: ***Cigarette***.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• When identifying the correct spelling of a word, it is helpful to compare it against a dictionary or reliable language resources.
 
• Spelling errors often occur due to phonetic similarities, but the correct spelling must align with standard English conventions.
